company.description:
Shuttle Inc. is a transnational company that produces mini-PCs, slim PCs, all-in-One PCs, digital signage players, notebooks, and tablets. It offers products for consumer, commercial, and vertical markets.

The company’s product line includes OBM (Own Branding and Manufacturing): XPC, slim PCs, all-in-One PCs, face-recognition access control, EDUPAL software solution, and SMARTVILLE software solution; and ODM (Own Design and Manufacturing): notebooks, netbooks, AIOs, 2-in-1 PCs, and tablets.

Shuttle Inc. was established in 1983 and has presence in in North and South America, Europe, Taiwan, and China.
